scope: Post-hoc paired diagnostic using the existing 113-patient native and physical-spacing cine ledgers. No thresholds or models are newly selected.
metric: Patient-macro recall at retrospective 20 percent matched FPR, all and adjacent verified absences.
interaction: Compute physical-spacing minus native differences in the bounded-minus-image-difference contrast within each seed/fold. Average the fixed fits and resample the same target patients for all scoring modes.
reporting: Report pooled and class-stratified estimates with pointwise 95 percent paired intervals, equal weighting of seeds and folds. For the same ventricular classes, subtract the raw-score geometry interaction from the centered-score interaction on each draw. The raw and centered comparison is post hoc; the registered primary analysis is retained.
